repo: Swamp3/bike-one-shop (existing repo; website/ merged in at the end)

decisions.choice: website/ is built as a standalone git repo (kit needs its own main + astro-rebuild), hidden from the parent via .git/info/exclude, then merged into bike-one-shop with history under website/
decisions.reason: user: use the repo we are in, website and shop combine; init-site always runs git init and commits to main
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the merge is a read-tree at the end

decisions.choice: out of scope: shop, product, category, brand, cart, checkout, account, wishlist paths excluded from capture
decisions.reason: user: ignore woocommerce, the new shop is this repo
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: excluded pages need a link or redirect to the new shop

decisions.choice: Cloudflare Pages; development on bike-one.dev, always noindex (PUBLIC_INDEXABLE unset)
decisions.reason: user: domain registered at Cloudflare; bike-one.dev must not be indexed

decisions.choice: woo default and German slugs: /shop/ /product/ /product-category/ /product-brand/ /brand/ /cart/ /checkout/ /my-account/ /wishlist/ /produkt/ /produkt-kategorie/ /warenkorb/ /kasse/ /mein-konto/ /wunschliste/
decisions.reason: real slugs unknown before capture; adjust with --resume --exclude

decisions.choice: trailing slash always (54 of 54 pages)
decisions.reason: capture

decisions.choice: live-temporary: 2009 files, 1156.7 MB, 5 over 25 MB (largest 91.9 MB mp4); R2 mode needed, no R2 credentials; staging serves /wp-content/uploads/ from bike-one.org. 4108 unreferenced WordPress sizes listed, not downloaded
decisions.reason: over 300 MB limit; no store credentials
decisions.costIfWrong: high if forgotten: bike-one.org is replaced at launch, so images break. Must move to R2 before DNS

decisions.choice: 10 templates from 55 pages as clustered (template-1 15 portfolio demo, page 10, archive 9 brands, template-2 7 team demo, single-post 5, page-3 4, archive-3 2, archive-2 1, home 1, page-2 1)
decisions.reason: capture/templates.json

decisions.choice: reproduce live (theme demo content: portfolio-name-N, member-0N, branding-design)
decisions.reason: parity; removal is a proposal

decisions.choice: reproduce live: 27 pages have no h1 (home, brands, categories, legal, booking, about)
decisions.reason: parity; fix is a proposal

decisions.choice: none to rewire: the only POST forms are WooCommerce add-to-cart on /, GET search on /Marke/*; markup reproduced, cart no longer works
decisions.reason: inventory.json forms

decisions.choice: home and category pages still show product markup and links into excluded /produkt/ paths; reproduced as is, add-to-cart stops working
decisions.reason: user: ignore woocommerce
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: dead product links on staging until the new shop takes those paths

decisions.choice: keep etermin.net booking iframes (/termin-buchen-oldenburg/, -osnabrueck/) and Google Maps iframes (/termin-buchen/)
decisions.reason: third-party embeds

decisions.choice: none found in capture/scripts.json
decisions.reason: capture

decisions.choice: skipped, not installed
decisions.reason: never install unasked
decisions.costIfWrong: suggestions list performance as Not covered

decisions.choice: 3 POST forms on / switched off: action=# and listed in inert-forms.json; no form endpoint, no Formspree
decisions.reason: cart forms must never post to a form service; shop is out of scope
decisions.costIfWrong: low: buttons do nothing until the new shop takes over

decisions.choice: src/layouts/Page.astro (plus Blank.astro for /alle-fahrrader/) for all 10 templates instead of one layout per template; header, mobile header and footer are components from home, pages with a current-menu-item copy use their own file
decisions.reason: all templates share the identical #page > .site-inner > header, mobile header, #main, footer skeleton; content moved by tools/extract.mjs

decisions.choice: reproduce live: fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet stays linked, the 20 fonts the capture saved under /fonts/ are not shipped
decisions.reason: parity; self-hosting is a proposal (German courts treat Google Fonts from Google servers as a GDPR issue)
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: GDPR exposure until proposed change is approved

decisions.choice: public/_headers adds X-Robots-Tag noindex for https://bike-one.dev/*; builds are noindex and robots Disallow all unless PUBLIC_INDEXABLE=true
decisions.reason: user: bike-one.dev must not be indexed

decisions.choice: reproduce live: every page links /wp-content/themes/cosy-child/favicon.png, which live answers 404; link kept, links exception per page
decisions.reason: parity; the root /favicon.ico is served

decisions.choice: the live wp-sitemap files are served from tools/sitemaps.mjs: URLs under the excluded WooCommerce prefixes (53) are dropped, the two sitemaps left empty (products, product categories) are dropped from the index, and /portfolio-category/branding-design/page/2/ is added because the sitemaps gate requires every indexable page and live omits it
decisions.reason: the sitemaps gate has no exception field; forced difference from live
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the new shop adds its own sitemap entries

decisions.topic: same-origin asset URLs root-relative / local media
decisions.choice: tools/extract.mjs rewrites live-origin URLs to root-relative in script/img/source/video src, srcset, stylesheet/icon/preload links, import maps, inline style url() and data-* lazy sources (<a href>, canonical, og and other head metadata stay); media mode is repo: 2009 files copied by assets:copy from .conversion/media-cache into public/wp-content/uploads, gitignored
decisions.default: same-origin asset URLs root-relative; media live-temporary
decisions.reason: user: serve images locally; live host was unreachable; build-rules default. data-* rewrite goes beyond the rule so the theme lazy loaders and the pager use local files
decisions.costIfWrong: medium: the 1.1 GB media is not in git; production needs R2 (5 files exceed the 25 MiB Cloudflare Pages limit) or another store

decisions.choice: dropped with their inline config: WooCommerce cart fragments (wc-cart-fragments-js, -extra), YITH add-to-wishlist (yith-wcwl-add-to-wishlist-js, -extra, -translations), WordPress emoji loader (wp-emoji-settings JSON and its module script); dev-host bikeone.cvires.at file URLs (blog images, slider poster) now point at the local copies
decisions.default: copy every script that drives visible behaviour; drop only scripts that do nothing on a static site
decisions.reason: user: fix console errors; each script only called endpoints that do not exist on a static host (405 on ?wc-ajax, wp-json/yith, wp-emoji-release.min.js on the live origin); the dev host leaked into live content
decisions.costIfWrong: low: browsers without flag-emoji support show country letters instead of flags; wishlist and cart widgets were already dead

decisions.choice: header and footer menus: GravelBikes, RoadBikes and TT/Triathlon replaced by one Shop item (tools/extract.mjs) linking to https://shop.bike-one.dev/ in local, dev and staging builds and to https://shop.bike-one.org/ in the release build (PUBLIC_INDEXABLE=true); SHOP_URL in src/lib/site.mjs; the pages /racebikes/, /tt-triathlon/ and /gravel-bikes/ stay built and unlinked
decisions.reason: owner request
decisions.costIfWrong: low: the shop sites must exist before launch; the three pages could be dropped with redirects if wanted

decisions.choice: tools/strip-sourcemaps.mjs removes sourceMappingURL comments from 3 served JS files (lightbox, swiper, yith add-to-wishlist); run it after npm run assets:copy
decisions.reason: the .map files were never captured, DevTools logs a source map error on every page

decisions.choice: inline script hero-video-autoplay added to / and /main-bike/: every 500 ms it plays the unstarted bg video of the visible Revolution Slider slide (muted); VidOne.mp4 stays at the absolute live URL because the file is not in the capture or the export
decisions.reason: owner report: poster shows until a click. Reproduced in WebKit (Safari engine): the slider never calls play() on the first video, a muted play() without gesture succeeds and the slider then fades the video in. Chrome autoplays by itself
decisions.costIfWrong: low: a no-op where autoplay already works; Safari with Low Power Mode can still block autoplay
